directions.short: In the corner of the Penketh precinct shops, off Meeting Lane.
directions.full: Find us in the corner of the horseshoe of shops at Penketh precinct, just off Meeting Lane and beside Penketh Pool and Community Centre. Free parking right outside.

booking.note: mode is the ONE setting for every Book button. "overlay" (agreed in CLAUDE.md; panel tested loading on localhost, desktop and phone, 8 Nov 2026): Phorest's booking panel slides in on the page, on phones too while overlayOnPhones is true; without JavaScript, or if the panel cannot load, the button opens the booking page instead. "newTab": every Book button opens the Phorest booking page in a new tab. Stage 10 makes a test booking on the live domain (desktop and a real iPhone); if booking fails inside the panel, set overlayOnPhones false (phones only) or mode "newTab". See COMPONENTS.md, Booking.
